fullDescription: A refined elegant glassmorphism dashboard design tailored for high-end fintech, AI SaaS, and premium management platforms. This style features a deep dark-mode aesthetic with a primary palette of black (#050505) and deep charcoal (#0a0a0a), accented by sophisticated grayscale glass panels and vibrant interactive highlights in blue (#3b82f6), emerald (#10b981), and rose (#f43f5e). The layout utilizes a bento-grid structure with floating glass cards, subtle ambient radial glows, and high-performance SVG animations. Typography is a pairing of the geometric 'Outfit' for display and 'Inter' for functional UI, creating a look that is minimalist yet authoritative. Perfect for data-heavy applications requiring sophisticated information hierarchy and visual depth.

structured.summary: A sophisticated glass-themed fintech dashboard with a minimalist black and white primary aesthetic, using high-blur glass surfaces, subtle ambient lighting, and vibrant accent colors for data visualization and micro-interactions.

style.description: The style essence is 'Refined Glass'. It relies on a neutral grayscale base with backdrop blurs fixed at 35px. Borders are thin (1px) and translucent white. Typography is clean and modern, using Outfit for branding/headers and Inter for body text. Animations are smooth and use custom cubic-beziers for a premium, weighty feel. Depth is created through layered glass effects rather than heavy shadows.
style.prompt: Create a design with a deep black base (#050505) and a grain texture overlay (35% opacity). Use glass panels with a backdrop-filter of 'blur(35px) saturate(150%)'. Glass backgrounds should be linear-gradients from top-to-bottom: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.09)' to 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)'. Apply a 1px solid border at 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)' with an inner white highlight '0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14)'. Typography specs: Headers in 'Outfit', Semibold, tracking -0.025em; Body in 'Inter', 400-500 weight; Data in 'JetBrains Mono'. Colors: primary white (#FFFFFF), secondary slate (#94A3B8), accents in Blue (#3B82F6), Emerald (#10B981), and Rose (#F43F5E). Animations: all transitions must use 'cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)' with a duration of 0.3s to 0.6s.

layout_and_structure.description: A classic dashboard structure featuring a fixed-width left sidebar and a flexible main content area. Content is organized into a modular bento-style grid with varying card sizes to establish visual hierarchy.

prompts.prompt: Width: 280px. Background: 'glass-soft' (blur 20px, 3.5% opacity). Layout: Vertical flex. Elements: Top logo area (44px square white box with black character), Navigation links with 17px icons and 14px text. Include a floating 'wallet card' at the bottom with a 'float' animation (translateY: -6px, 5s duration).

Horizontal flex layout. Left side: 30px display heading with 14px date/greeting subtext. Right side: 224px wide glass search bar, white primary button with heavy glow 'shadow-[0_10px_28px_-8px_rgba(255,255,255,0.4)]', and a circular avatar (40px) with slate gradient.

Large 'glass-strong' card (blur 35px, 14% top opacity). Layout: Flex-between. Left: 'Outfit' 48px balance display with 11px uppercase labels. Bottom stats row with 18px semibold figures and 1px top border. Right: Large SVG area (420px x 130px) featuring a smooth white line chart with a 'shimmerLine' stroke-dash animation.

Three-column grid. Each card is 'glass' (35px blur). Card 1: Rose accent for spending. Card 2: Blue accent for usage. Card 3: Emerald accent for savings. Each card features a small SVG area chart (h-14) at the bottom.

Full-width glass-strong panel. Header with 'View all' link. Content: Vertical list of rows with hover states 'background: rgba(255,255,255,0.025)'. Icons in 40px rounded-xl glass boxes with themed colors (Blue, Emerald, Amber). Right-aligned monospaced currency values.

special_ui_components.description: A multi-layered glass panel with sophisticated lighting effects.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply 'backdrop-filter: blur(35px)'. Set 'background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.09), rgba(255,255,255,0.02))'. Add a 'glass::before' pseudo-element for a 1px border gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.28), rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 35%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%)' using mask-composite to keep it on the edge only.

special_ui_components.description: Subtle, non-distracting background lighting to add depth to the dark base.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply two radial gradients to the fixed background layer. Top-left: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 70%)' with a 55px blur filter. Bottom-right: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 70%)'. Width/Height of each should be approx 640px-720px.

special_ui_components.description: A multi-colored SVG donut chart with rounded caps and gap effects.
special_ui_components.prompt: Circle SVG with radius 46. Stroke-width 16. Use stroke-dasharray and negative stroke-dashoffset to create segments: Blue (#3b82f6), Emerald (#10b981), Amber (#f59e0b), and Slate (#64748b). Stroke-linecap must be 'round'.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain the 35px blur and 1px border on all glass panels to ensure depth consistency. MUST NOT: Use solid black or heavy shadows for panel definition; use border highlights instead. MUST: Keep interactive elements like 'Quick Action' buttons on a glass-soft background to avoid visual clutter. MUST: Animate all elements on entrance using a fade-up with staggered delays (0.05s increments).
